section_summary.extract_value: This Introduction reviews literature linking body image (mostly negative body image) to sexual health and sexual functioning and proposes that positive body image may relate to broader sexual outcomes such as sexual liberalism and exploration. It highlights limitations of the existing literature (reliance on measures of negative body image, use of the Sexual Opinion Survey, focus on women, and small college samples) and does not present any primary study data or label any study (e.g., 'Study 1').
section_summary.evidence_source: "To date, however, few studies have examined associations between body image and sexual outcomes beyond health outcomes and sexual functioning." "Finally, previous studies have tended to rely on small samples of college-aged individuals, whose sexual experiences may not generalize to wider populations."
